title: Conversion to a straight-line program
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs, suppose every gate has at most two arguments, and choose an input index $i_0\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. The associated straight-line program consists of the statements produced by the dual-rail translation of the circuit's gate list, followed by one conjunction statement whose two operands are both the first rail at the circuit's output vertex.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate in $C$ has at most two arguments
